project_name: Improve a clinic appointment reminder workflow
description: Improve a clinic appointment reminder workflow for patients by combining SMS reminders, staff follow-up, privacy review, and a four-week pilot measurement plan.
summary: A medium complexity healthcare workflow improvement in the healthcare domain.

phases.name: Workflow Discovery
phases.objective: Understand current clinical or administrative workflow.

tasks.title: Map current workflow
tasks.description: Document steps, roles, handoffs, and pain points.
acceptance_criteria: Map current workflow is reviewed and accepted by the project lead.

tasks.title: Identify compliance constraints
tasks.description: Capture privacy, security, and policy requirements.
acceptance_criteria: Identify compliance constraints is reviewed and accepted by the project lead.

phases.name: Solution Design
phases.objective: Design process and technology changes without assuming unsafe integrations.

tasks.title: Define future-state workflow
tasks.description: Design improved scheduling, reminders, and staff responsibilities.
acceptance_criteria: Define future-state workflow is reviewed and accepted by the project lead.

tasks.title: Plan pilot
tasks.description: Define pilot scope, success metrics, training, and rollback plan.
acceptance_criteria: Plan pilot is reviewed and accepted by the project lead.

phases.name: Pilot and Measurement
phases.objective: Launch a controlled pilot and measure operational impact.

tasks.title: Train staff
tasks.description: Prepare staff to execute the updated workflow.
acceptance_criteria: Train staff is reviewed and accepted by the project lead.

tasks.title: Measure outcomes
tasks.description: Track backlog, reminder success, patient experience, and staff workload.
acceptance_criteria: Measure outcomes is reviewed and accepted by the project lead.

milestones.name: Workflow Discovery Complete
milestones.description: All deliverables for Workflow Discovery are complete and reviewed.

milestones.name: Solution Design Complete
milestones.description: All deliverables for Solution Design are complete and reviewed.

milestones.name: Pilot and Measurement Complete
milestones.description: All deliverables for Pilot and Measurement are complete and reviewed.

dependencies.description: T2 depends on completion of T1.
T3 depends on completion of T2.

T6 depends on completion of T5.

risks.description: Project scope may expand beyond the initial plan.
risks.mitigation: Maintain an explicit MVP scope and review changes before adding work.

risks.description: Missing stakeholder input may lead to rework.
risks.mitigation: Confirm requirements and acceptance criteria before implementation.

risks.description: Privacy or compliance requirements may constrain the solution.
risks.mitigation: Run compliance review before pilot or integration work.

risks.description: Healthcare workflows may require privacy, compliance, and security review.
risks.mitigation: Reduce scope, extend timeline, or define a smaller pilot.

recommendations.recommendation: Use milestones as decision gates before expanding scope.
recommendations.rationale: Decision gates reduce rework and keep dependencies visible.
